scope: Direct local mechanical suites only; not a reproduction of Liquid's seven-task aggregate.

objective_fidelity.interpretation: QAD has lower perplexity than PTQ on both fixed local corpora. These repeated local corpora are an objective diagnostic, not a calibrated quality-retention percentage; QAD's lower value than BF16 confirms that perplexity is not a valid BF16-retention conversion here.

mechanical_practical.denominator_note: BF16 did not score above PTQ on this intentionally small exact-match suite, so BF16 retention and PTQ-to-BF16 gap recovery are mathematically undefined. They are not reported as percentages.

conclusion: QAD materially improves the narrow perplexity diagnostic versus PTQ, but no material practical-score uplift was demonstrated in this bounded campaign.
